title: Full benchmark and production medium repeat baseline
scope: benchmark evidence and workflow record only

production_medium_repeat.gate_readiness: usable as an execution/error gate and a provisional performance baseline; latency gates should account for unstable LDBC and micro-case variance

current_capability: YCSB-like point read, point update, short range scan, secondary-index equality, insert, and mixed read/update throughput.
TPC-C-like new order, payment, order status, stock level, and delivery status operations.
TPC-H-like pricing summary, segment revenue, revenue filter, returned-item revenue, and top-orders queries.
Search workloads for FTS MATCH, LIKE prefix/contains, vector nearest neighbor, and embedding function.
memtier-like SQL key/value GET, SET, ADD, and mixed GET/SET throughput.
TSBS-like tag/time range, fleet rollup, latest points, and single-point ingest.
LDBC-like one-hop, recent posts, tag popularity, and two-hop traversal queries.
ANN HNSW nearest-neighbor, filtered nearest-neighbor, vector insert, and recall@k metrics.
CH-benCHmark-like hybrid OLTP/OLAP throughput, warehouse revenue rollup, and customer-order join.
main_hotspots: TSBS Fleet rollup by region remains the slowest all-suite case at p95 41.240 ms.
ANN HNSW nearest neighbor is p95 40.304 ms with recall@10 1.000 on the local synthetic medium dataset.
CH-benCHmark Customer order join is p95 26.503 ms.
LDBC suite latency stability is weak: p95 CV 16.35%, spread 37.23%.
Unstable production cases: LDBC Tag popularity, TSBS Ingest one point, TPC-C Stock level query, memtier ADD new key, CH Warehouse revenue rollup, TPC-C Delivery status update.
next_task_signals: BENCHPROD-048: Optimize and stabilize LDBC Tag popularity using repeat/stability gates.

BENCHPROD-055: Add TSBS official data/query adapter path and timestamp-native coverage.
BENCHPROD-056: Add ANN real-dataset import plus external ground-truth validation.
BENCHPROD-057: Add CH-benCHmark official-shape schema/query coverage and mixed HTAP snapshot checks.
